ui.chat.key_set: equal to English; no extra or missing key

findings.current: Ir a tu mensaje del turno {turn, number} de {total, number}, a las {clock}
findings.problem: The catalogue text is correct Spanish and needs no change; the composition is what is off. The {clock} argument is not the locale-formatted time the sidecar promises: checkpointClockLabel() in src/renderer/src/features/chat/canonical/checkpoint-model.ts:212-221 hand-builds a 12-hour string with the English markers "AM"/"PM", so a Spanish screen-reader user hears "Ir a tu mensaje del turno 3 de 7, a las 3:42 PM". "a las" is the right Spanish frame for a clock value, so dropping the time half would be a worse omission; the blemish is the English meridiem inside Spanish prose, and it is identical in all seven locales because the value comes from one code path.
findings.suggested: No catalogue change. Route {clock} through the locale-aware time formatter (or let the catalogue own the meridiem) in checkpointClockLabel(), keeping the es value as it is; re-audit only if the {clock} shape changes.
findings.evidence: audit.log '=== clock variants for ui.chat.checkpoint.jump_user ===' plus the rendered row in the per-key table

observations.topic: house term for the composer (asked for by the coordinator)
observations.detail: Checked as instructed: the es catalogue has no single settled term. English "composer" is rendered "compositor" in ui.chat.aside.empty and ui.chat.question_dock.hint.approval_held, and "cuadro de mensaje" in ui.canvas.create_file_dialog.change_the_working_directory_from_the_composer_to_create_the_file_elsewh and ui.chat.pickers.destination_pickers.stores_a_secret_for_this_session_s_tools_by_name_the_value_never_appears; English "message box" is rendered "cuadro de mensaje" in ui.chat.question_dock.hint.approval and ui.chat.question_dock.hint.approval_held. Of the five English "composer" sites, three now say "compositor" (the two above plus the new key) and two say "cuadro de mensaje". The new ui.chat.region.composer = "Compositor de mensajes" therefore follows the rendering already used for the composer and contradicts no house term; the two pre-existing "cuadro de mensaje" sites that stand for "composer" are the outliers, and "cuadro de mensaje" is itself ambiguous with a message bubble. Recommendation: align those two pre-existing values to "compositor" in a separate change; the 38-key delta needs no change.

The composed name is Spanish up to the closure clause and then carries the backend's English sentence ("Agente: Nova. The runtime closed this seat…"). The sidecar states {reason} is served in English and passed through unchanged, so the pass-through is correct as specified; it is a known mixed-language utterance in every locale, not an es defect.

observations.topic: answer vs response distinctness (asked for by the coordinator)
observations.detail: Verified against the call site (src/renderer/src/features/chat/canonical/message-actions-row.tsx:528-536): the row picks yours_label / commentary_actions.label / response_actions.label / answer_label by kind, and the code comment requires that a non-closing response row must not announce the answer row's name. es renders the pair as "Acciones de la respuesta" (response, pre-existing) and "Acciones de la respuesta final" (answer, new): distinct when spoken, and "final" is the honest mark of the closing answer. Spanish has one word for both English nouns, so a trailing adjective is the smallest available differentiator. Accepted; no finding.
